title: Federal Civil Service Annuity in the Veterans Pension Recurring Income
content:
**Annuity schedule — Veterans Pension recurring countable income.** A federal civil service annuity under the Federal Employees Retirement System receives the reduced cost-of-living increase that system grants each December. In the redetermination of the recurring countable income on a Veterans Pension award, the annuity figure on the veteran's most recent annuity report is raised by the whole months since its level took effect:

| Level took effect | Raise | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more whole months before the redetermination | the two most recent reduced increases together | 1.0404 |
| 12 to 23 whole months before | the most recent reduced increase | 1.02 |
| under 12 whole months before | none — used as reported | 1 |

The raised figure is rounded to the cent.

*Hypothetical annuity of 20000.00:* 20000.00 under 12 months; 20400.00 at 12 to 23 months; 20808.00 at 24 months or more.
